newsitem.title: UK: UK FTSE stays firm on strong retailers, BT tumbles.
newsitem.headline: UK FTSE stays firm on strong retailers, BT tumbles.

text.p: Leading UK shares stayed moderately higher in a broad-based rally on Friday as investors went shopping for companies with a high proportion of domestic sales, dealers said.
The benchmark FTSE 100 was 14.3 points higher at 4,782.1 by 1020 GMT, after briefly touching the psychologically-important 4,800 mark. Advancers led decliners by a 78 to 15 margin.

The most actively traded stock in London was British Telecommunications Plc, which tumbled after MCI Communications Corp posted a profit warning late on Thursday. BT and MCI are set for a $24 billion merger.
